V and companions return to surface, invite Hessa and her previously established husband to meet both warders. Both voluntarily meet at shaded abutment entrance; Rhevan and Ossric emerge into shade, weapons undrawn; all four skeletons remain at original posts. Hessa initially recoils, husband cautious. Rhevan apologetically explains changed purpose, Ossric promises household's home remains theirs and protection without service or tribute, consistent with V's existing orders; Cirren meaningfully Helps explain accepted agreement. Predeclared V Persuasion +7 advantage DC15 for cautious household acceptance; actual executed visible Python secrets receipt batch f4c12f2d2bb6c05c42674582a54c6729 d20 faces2,18 keep18+7=25 success. Hessa and husband agree to try coexistence and accept voluntary protection, not unconditional trust, guarantee of safety, legal approval of undead deployment or title. Husband asks about stone-wall mending, Ossric says he has had time to learn; this is NPC statement, not verified trade proficiency, quote or labor contract. No repair order, cost, wages, coercion, rent, new grant, structural inspection, property boundaries or evidence retrieval. Warders remain subject to actual 2014 traits including sunlight sensitivity, no automatic ability to safely resist predation certified. No new resource expenditure, attack or rest. Day331~16:50. V next action.
